en.title: Programs
en.imageAlt: Program participants collaborating during a business workshop.
en.metaDescription: Explore LATAM China Tech programs for market entry, business missions, and cross-border growth.
en.bodyHtml:
Programs give companies a structured path from exploration to action. Each cohort combines market briefings, partner discovery, pitch preparation, and targeted introductions.

Market entry support is practical by design: every milestone is tied to a decision, meeting, application, or commercial next step.

sections.title: Market entry cohorts
sections.bodyHtml:
Cohorts help companies assess demand, validate positioning, and build the partner map needed before entering China or Latin America.

  • Sector and city readiness briefings.
  • Partner and customer discovery.
  • Localized pitch and application support.

sections.title: Delegations and business missions
sections.bodyHtml: Mission programs combine curated meetings, ecosystem visits, investor sessions, and operational briefings for delegations that need high-context access.

sections.title: Cohort 8 now open
sections.bodyHtml: The first-version cohort page is ready for live editing in Keystatic. Replace this placeholder with dates, selection criteria, and the final application path when the program opens.

br.title: Programas
br.imageAlt: Participantes colaborando durante um workshop de negocios.
br.metaDescription: Explore programas da LATAM China Tech para entrada em mercado, missoes de negocios e crescimento cross-border.
br.bodyHtml:
Programas dao as empresas uma rota estruturada da exploracao para a acao. Cada cohort combina briefings de mercado, descoberta de parceiros, preparacao de pitch e introducoes direcionadas.

O suporte de entrada em mercado e pratico por desenho: cada marco leva a uma decisao, reuniao, aplicacao ou proximo passo comercial.

sections.title: Cohorts de entrada em mercado
sections.bodyHtml:
Cohorts ajudam empresas a avaliar demanda, validar posicionamento e montar o mapa de parceiros antes de entrar na China ou na America Latina.

  • Briefings de setor e cidade.
  • Descoberta de parceiros e clientes.
  • Suporte de pitch e aplicacao localizado.

sections.title: Delegacoes e missoes de negocios
sections.bodyHtml: Missoes combinam reunioes curatoriais, visitas de ecossistema, sessoes com investidores e briefings operacionais para delegacoes que precisam de acesso qualificado.

sections.title: Cohort 8 aberto
sections.bodyHtml: Esta primeira versao ja pode ser editada no Keystatic. Substitua este placeholder por datas, criterios de selecao e caminho final de aplicacao quando o programa abrir.

cn.title: 项目
cn.imageAlt: 项目参与者正在商务工作坊中协作。
cn.metaDescription: 探索 LATAM China Tech 的市场进入、商务考察和跨境增长项目。
cn.bodyHtml:
项目为企业提供从探索到行动的结构化路径。每个 cohort 都结合市场简报、伙伴发现、路演准备和定向引荐。

市场进入支持以实际执行为核心：每个节点都对应一个决策、会议、申请或商业下一步。

sections.title: 市场进入 cohort
sections.bodyHtml:
Cohort 帮助企业评估需求、验证定位，并在进入中国或拉美之前建立伙伴地图。

  • 行业与城市准备度简报。
  • 伙伴和客户发现。
  • 本地化路演和申请支持。

sections.title: 代表团与商务考察
sections.bodyHtml: 商务考察项目结合定制会议、生态访问、投资人交流和运营简报，适合需要高语境接入的代表团。

sections.title: Cohort 8 开放中
sections.bodyHtml: 这个第一版本已可在 Keystatic 中编辑。项目开放后，可替换为正式日期、筛选标准和最终申请路径。
